candidate_comparison.name: Raw accepted-state physical admission in dynamic_collision_driver
candidate_comparison.decision_basis: Smallest line cost and highest direct physics false-success movement: it prevents clipped or floored derivatives from laundering an invalid accepted state.
behavior_contract: Preserve the existing solver-success and expected-terminal-event preconditions.

Before clipping, flooring, Hubble evaluation, or N_eff construction, admit the raw accepted state only if every value is finite, T>0, every occupation satisfies strict 0<f<1, raw densities are nonnegative, H^2 is finite and positive, and existing normalization/conservation predicates pass.
On any failed predicate, return one existing typed failure result with the raw offending state and predicate; do not emit N_eff or success and do not call postprocessing.
Clipped values may exist only as explicitly non-authoritative visualization derivatives after raw admission; they cannot affect terminal classification.
mathematical_numerical_preconditions: Spectral density weights used by admission are nonnegative under the frozen convention.
Strict-open occupation and positive-temperature domains are checked on raw binary64 values without repair.
H^2 and conserved/normalized quantities use the unchanged physical formulae, signs, units, and tolerances.
candidate_surfaces: dynamic_collision_driver.py at the raw-state-to-postprocessing boundary identified by the sealed audit (basename only; no broader source discovery was authorized)
adjacent focused tests; no new wrapper, registry, or public entrypoint

prospective_blocker_movement_ratio.ceiling: A real false-success path can be closed, but no endpoint, wall, or scientific gate moves.

minimal_tests: Inject negative density, f<=0, f>=1, NaN/Inf, and H^2<=0 into an otherwise solver-success/terminal-event result; each returns failure before Hubble/N_eff/postprocessing calls.
Use spies to prove zero clipping-derived admission and zero N_eff construction on invalid raw input.
A valid frozen fixture remains bitwise unchanged in terminal observables and classification.
candidate_comparison.scientific_numerical_validation: Domain, positivity, finiteness, sign, limiting-boundary, normalization, and conservation checks only. These tests validate the admission contract, not a trajectory or endpoint.
candidate_comparison.compatibility: Valid accepted states remain behavior-compatible. Previously silently repaired invalid states become explicit failures; this intentional incompatibility is the fix.
candidate_comparison.dependency_public_api_effect: No new dependency and no public API or capability claim. Reuse the existing result/failure surface.
candidate_comparison.rollback_cost: LOW: one existing driver boundary plus adjacent tests; revert restores the former behavior without data migration.
candidate_comparison.hard_falsifier: Any invalid raw state reaches N_eff/success, any failure is decided from clipped values, or the valid-path fixture changes.
candidate_comparison.residual_claim_ceiling: IMPLEMENTED only after code and focused tests execute; even then, physics false-success repair only, with G-F10-INDEPENDENT-FLRW unchanged.

candidate_comparison.name: Typed NumPy Rodas event, configuration, outcome, and test-contract repair
candidate_comparison.decision_basis: One existing state machine can remove a reproduced fabricated terminal event and three adjacent false-success/common-mode classes without creating a new solver or wrapper surface.
behavior_contract: Validate finite state shape/dtype, rtol>0, every atol>0, 0<h_min<=h_init<=h_max, positive integer work/reuse bounds, and supported Jacobian controls before the first RHS call; never coerce invalid values.

Support exactly one scalar terminal event in this bounded lane. A nonterminal event or an event sequence of length other than one returns an explicit UnsupportedEventContract before stepping; silent ignore is forbidden.

Interpret direction by sign: zero accepts either orientation, positive only negative-to-nonnegative, negative only positive-to-nonpositive; fractional directions such as 0.5 are not truncated, and time reversal applies the same oriented-surface rule consistently.
A finite exact initial root terminates at t0. A nonfinite event value is typed failure. A reported later event requires a finite oriented bracket and |g(t_event,y_event)|<=event_tol.

Use a safeguarded, separately budgeted refinement. Exhaustion or any failed refinement substep returns EventRefinementFailed with no t_events; the full substep fallback and message-text success inference are deleted.
A supplied Jacobian is used when present; otherwise use representable scale-aware finite differences tied to atol, rtol, and component magnitude. Unsupported Jacobian options fail explicitly.

Terminal precedence is invalid-input/invalid-physics/nonfinite/internal-error/budget/missed-event before success. stored_output_points, attempted_steps, accepted_steps, rejected_steps, nfev, njev, nlu, and event-refinement work remain distinct, exact units; len(t) is never a step count.
Properties and mutants target the declared invariants independently; NumPy/JAX parity alone is not acceptance evidence.
mathematical_numerical_preconditions: Event functions are finite scalar maps on admitted states and the declared residual tolerance is fixed before tests.
Finite-difference perturbations are representable, remain inside the state domain, and pass a directional residual/step-ladder check.
Refinement work has a finite budget independent of ordinary attempt counts and is reported without hiding linear/RHS work.

candidate_comparison.name: Moment-constrained slow-manifold discriminator with full-grid residual and adjoint QoI certificate
candidate_comparison.decision_basis: It is the only candidate with a plausible mechanism for the dominant call-count gap, but the sealed evidence does not yet freeze the moment basis, rank/grid ladder, entropy metric, coercivity neighborhood, tail enclosure, or adjoint QoIs tightly enough for implementation.
behavior_contract: Stage S0 is a prospectively sealed static discriminator only. It consumes only retained physical-prefix fixture states, models the 182-state three-bank order-60/ymax-30 independent system, and emits physical_prefix_executed=false and d071_reopen_earned=false.

Before any code, freeze moments, entropy-compatible weighted inner product, invariant-null projection P, Q=I-P, rank r, state/block scales, strict positivity neighborhood, quadrature/tail rule, operation order, QoIs, tolerances, and hard rejection criteria. The 122-state folded Rust model is never substituted.

At every admitted static state certify projector identities and invariant preservation, transverse coercivity mu_W(Q J_C Q)<=-lambda, a nonlinear remainder bound L*rho with lambda-L*rho>0, forcing enclosure, strict-domain margin, conservation, and a full-grid plus tail residual bound.
Propagate residual/manifold/quadrature/tail error through a predeclared adjoint QoI certificate. A moment match without full-grid residual and tail control is automatic failure.

Centered componentwise JVP ladders and at least two independent Krylov seeds may be diagnostics only. One global epsilon, one-vector Arnoldi termination, or derivative/Jacobian removal cannot satisfy S0.

Only a separate owner decision after S0 may authorize Stage S1. S1 starts from the physical initial state, never from log-derived N approximately 0.1653, includes N=0.14 and N=0.22, reaches N>=0.25, and stays within <=5500 full-RHS-equivalent calls and <=64800 seconds in one pass.
S0 or S1 failure is preserved and terminal; there is no tuning sweep, grid/tolerance/cap relaxation, second pass, endpoint claim, or gate flip.
mathematical_numerical_preconditions: The chosen slow branch exists uniquely in the declared neighborhood and the invariant-null subspace is separated before coercivity measurement.
Rank remains bounded under the prospectively frozen grid-order check; growth with grid order falsifies reduction.
Exact collision certification remains Theta(M^2); reduced algebra O(b*M*r^2+b*r^3) must not hide full-grid certificate work.

The certificate includes dimensions, signs, strict occupation/temperature domains, conservation, positivity, limiting cases, branch choice, quadrature, spatial/angular/radial/tail uncertainty, and reproducible full-RHS-equivalent accounting.
